retrievalProfile.description: A chaotic, pink-washed sketchbook aesthetic featuring charcoal-textured doodles of characters and symbols with a playful yet edgy vibe.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central cherubic character with horns and a halo surrounded by a dense field of charcoal-drawn icons including flowers, stars, and animals, all set against a textured pink and off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character as the primary focal point
Dense peripheral doodles creating a frame-like effect
High contrast between dark charcoal lines and bright pink wash
Rough, textured strokes unifying disparate icons
coreInvariants: Charcoal-like texture on all line work
Vibrant pink color wash as the primary background element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central character occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character's large, dark eyes and halo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement from the center outward to the surrounding icons, then to the top-right text area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded with small doodles.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation pink against low-value black lines and high-value white base.

letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent baseline for a playful feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Heart shapes substituted for certain counters or vowels
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style decorative lettering used for all text elements to maintain the sketchbook theme.
graphicDevices: Integrated small icons like hearts and stars

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick, soft-edged stroke of the original lettering.
Captures the grainy, analog feel of the charcoal medium.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a pink and off-white textured background with charcoal-style doodles of a central horned character, flowers, stars, and small animals in a messy sketchbook style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in the top right corner using a thick, rounded charcoal-textured style that matches the surrounding doodles.

verificationChecks: Is the charcoal texture consistent across lines and text?
Is the pink wash vibrant and central to the background?
Does the lettering feel integrated into the doodle aesthetic?
Is the central character the clear focal point?

postGenerationChecks: Check for charcoal texture on all black elements
Ensure the pink color does not overwhelm the line work
Verify the 'messy' sketchbook layout is maintained
Confirm no clean vector elements are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vibrant pink watercolor wash with a dense layer of charcoal-textured doodles and heavy, rounded hand-lettering to create a cohesive sketchbook aesthetic.
